# RP Shield

> RP Shield Solutions Inc. provides human-first scam support and cybersecurity protection for seniors, families, and small businesses in Saint John, New Brunswick, Canada.

## Official Website

- [RP Shield](https://rpshield.ca/): Official website and overview of RP Shield services.

## Protection Plans

- [Home Protection](https://rpshield.ca/#plans): Scam support and computer protection for individuals and families.
- [Business Protection](https://rpshield.ca/#plans): Cybersecurity support and monitoring for small businesses and their devices.

## Company Information

- [About RP Shield](https://rpshield.ca/#about): Information about the company and its human-first approach to cybersecurity.
- [Contact RP Shield](https://rpshield.ca/#contact): Contact form for questions.
